intro.title: Reading: My Town
intro.explanation: Read descriptions of towns and neighborhoods using location words and adjectives.
intro.cultureNote: Many Japanese towns have a distinct character. People often describe their area by nearby stations, shops, and parks.

items.passage: 私の町は静かです。駅の近くにスーパーと病院があります。公園もあります。公園には大きい桜の木があります。
items.translation: My town is quiet. Near the station there is a supermarket and a hospital. There is also a park. In the park there is a big cherry blossom tree.

questions.question: What is the town like?
What is near the station?
options: A bank and a post office

questions.question: What is in the park?

items.passage: この町にはレストランがたくさんあります。イタリア料理のレストランが一番人気です。安くておいしいですから。
items.translation: There are many restaurants in this town. The Italian restaurant is the most popular. Because it is cheap and delicious.

questions.question: What kind of restaurant is the most popular?
Why is it popular?

items.passage: 私の家は駅から歩いて十五分です。ちょっと遠いですが、静かな所にあるので好きです。
items.translation: My house is a 15-minute walk from the station. It is a little far, but I like it because it is in a quiet place.

questions.question: How far is the house from the station?
Why does the speaker like the location?

intro.title: Reading: Travel
intro.explanation: Read short travel stories using past tense, te-form, and descriptive expressions.
intro.cultureNote: Domestic travel is very popular in Japan. Many people travel during Golden Week, Obon, and New Year holidays.

items.passage: 先月、京都に旅行しました。お寺をたくさん見ました。きれいでした。日本の料理も食べました。特に天ぷらがおいしかったです。
items.translation: Last month I traveled to Kyoto. I saw many temples. They were beautiful. I also ate Japanese food. Especially the tempura was delicious.

questions.question: When did the speaker travel?
What did the speaker see in Kyoto?
What food did the speaker especially like?

items.passage: 来月友達と北海道に行くつもりです。飛行機で行きます。スキーをしたいです。ホテルはもう予約しました。
items.translation: Next month I plan to go to Hokkaido with my friend. We will go by plane. I want to ski. I already reserved a hotel.

questions.question: How will they get to Hokkaido?
What does the speaker want to do in Hokkaido?

items.passage: 沖縄の海はとてもきれいでした。シュノーケリングをしました。魚をたくさん見ました。三日間いました。短かったです。
items.translation: The sea in Okinawa was very beautiful. I went snorkeling. I saw many fish. I stayed for three days. It was short.

questions.question: What did the speaker do in Okinawa?
How long did the speaker stay?

intro.title: Reading: School Life
intro.explanation: Read about school activities using conditional forms and expressing reasons.
intro.cultureNote: Japanese schools often have club activities (部活動) after classes. Students are very dedicated to their clubs.

items.passage: 私は毎日学校で日本語を勉強しています。テストがあるので、たくさん勉強しなければなりません。でも、日本語は面白いです。
items.translation: I study Japanese at school every day. Because there is a test, I have to study a lot. But Japanese is interesting.

questions.question: Why does the speaker study a lot?
How does the speaker feel about Japanese?

items.passage: 部活はテニス部です。毎日練習しています。来週大会があります。頑張りたいです。
items.translation: My club activity is tennis club. I practice every day. There is a tournament next week. I want to do my best.

questions.question: What club is the speaker in?
When is the tournament?

items.passage: 今日の昼ご飯はカレーライスでした。学校の食堂で食べました。安くて量が多いので好きです。
items.translation: Today's lunch was curry rice. I ate at the school cafeteria. I like it because it's cheap and the portions are big.

questions.question: What did the speaker eat for lunch?
Why does the speaker like the cafeteria?
options: It's cheap and portions are big

items.passage: 夏休みにアルバイトをするつもりです。本屋で働きたいです。本が好きだからです。
items.translation: I plan to work a part-time job during summer vacation. I want to work at a bookstore. Because I like books.

questions.question: When does the speaker plan to work?
Where does the speaker want to work?

intro.title: Reading: Health and Weather
intro.explanation: Read about health, weather, and how they connect using te-form and conditionals.
intro.cultureNote: In Japan, wearing a mask when sick is common courtesy. People also take care to dress warmly in cold weather.

items.passage: 昨日から頭が痛いです。熱もあります。今日は学校を休みます。薬を飲んで寝ます。
items.translation: I've had a headache since yesterday. I also have a fever. Today I will be absent from school. I will take medicine and sleep.

questions.question: What symptoms does the speaker have?
What will the speaker do today?

items.passage: 今日はとても暑いです。三十五度です。たくさん水を飲んだ方がいいです。外で遊ばないでください。
items.translation: Today is very hot. It's 35 degrees. You should drink a lot of water. Please don't play outside.

questions.question: What is the temperature today?
What advice is given?

items.passage: 明日の天気は曇りです。午後から雨が降るかもしれません。傘を持って行った方がいいです。
items.translation: Tomorrow's weather is cloudy. It might rain from the afternoon. You should bring an umbrella.

questions.question: What is tomorrow's weather?
What should you bring?
